0.why: PanelTone.cpp:201-204 reads the jack with getVoltage and a SchmittTrigger set to 0.1V and 5V while the switch is on Trigger

comment: The input jack does two different things. On Trigger it is read by a Schmitt trigger at 0.1V and 5V (PanelTone.cpp:201-204); on Continuous the voltage is scaled by 0.1 to set the overlay strength (PanelTone.cpp:386), which makes it a 0-10V control voltage input. It is coloured as a trigger here because that is the setting the module comes up in, and because the maker renames the jack to Go trigger or Fade amount to match (PanelTone.cpp:190-194). The module menu carries nothing but the theme choices, so it has no line here; everything else is on the hamburger at the top of the panel.
